context: Flow cytometry (single-cell) measurements of 11 signaling readouts. Each variable is a marker intensity representing the abundance of a specific phosphorylated protein site or a phospholipid (PIP2/PIP3) in individual cells.

variables.name: PKC
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout detecting phosphorylated PKC-alpha, -betaI, -betaII, -delta, -epsilon, -eta, and -theta isoforms at the C-terminal residue homologous to S660 of PKC-betaII.

variables.name: PKA
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout detecting proteins/peptides containing a phospho-Ser/Thr residue with arginine at the −3 position (a motif-based PKA substrate readout).

variables.name: Raf
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of Raf phosphorylation at S259.

variables.name: Mek
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of MEK phosphorylation at S217 and S221.

variables.name: Erk
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of ERK phosphorylation at T202 and Y204.

variables.name: Akt
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of Akt phosphorylation at S473.

variables.name: Jnk
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of JNK phosphorylation at T183 and Y185.

variables.name: P38
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of p38 phosphorylation at T180 and Y182.

variables.name: Plcg
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout of PLCγ phosphorylation at Y783.

variables.name: PIP3
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout detecting the phospholipid PIP3.

variables.name: PIP2
variables.description: Flow cytometry readout detecting the phospholipid PIP2.
